items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the routine comfortable for skin that may still be sensitive after your recent medication.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the look of a smooth, comfortable skin barrier and helps with the lower moisture score.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily choice, and it matters more if you add exfoliating acids later.

response.routine_note: I've held back the glycolic toner for now: skin can stay sensitive for a while after isotretinoin, so please check with your dermatologist or prescriber before starting any exfoliating acid. Meanwhile, cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the SPF each morning.
